In rollouts 0, 1, and 3, PF2 was properly revealed by A3 via a reveal action and cited in justification_fact_ids. The settlement's commitment nonetheless mentions 'Jordan (19:00-23:00) and Maya from Unit 3 (23:00-07:00)', but this was derived from A3's say text, not a formal reveal. So rollout 2 combines a disclosure problem (A3 used say instead of reveal) with the same encoding mismatch (no decisions field for South coverage).
